answer: In the BlogCatalog perturbation analysis, adding missing edges hurts Macro-F1 the most when the graph is made denser by adding a relatively large fraction of non-edges, especially under the more local/biased node2vec settings (low return parameter p and/or low in-out parameter q). In that regime, the added edges most strongly distort the neighborhood structure that node2vec relies on, so Macro-F1 drops more than it does when edges are removed.
